tp:taxonomyPackage.tp:name: SEC Regulation Crypto Assets (Reg CA) Taxonomy - Complete Model
tp:taxonomyPackage.tp:description: One taxonomy for the seven forms of proposed Regulation Crypto Assets (Release 33-11434; File No. S7-2026-27): Forms NOR, 1-SU (proposed by Auditchain Labs), 1-CRYPTO, 1-KC, 1-SC, 1-UC and TR. Draft prepared by Auditchain Labs AG for comment. Not an official taxonomy of the Securities and Exchange Commission.
